mechanics: HUD.Drag -> ABBird.DragBird projects any drag farther than _dragRadius (1 world unit, BirdRed prefab) onto the drag circle; LaunchBird applies an impulse proportional to the clamped displacement, so every drag beyond the circle launches at the same (maximum) speed in the drag direction
removal_rule: a candidate the engine realizes as an identical launch (angle and speed) to a lower-ordinal candidate is removed before freeze
